name: a2ui-copilotkit-forms
description: Say what you want to do; the agent reads the API's schema and draws the form.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm boundaries
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n api,runtime,web -c green,magenta,cyan "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:runtime" "sh -c 'sleep 3 && pnpm dev:web'"
